scope: Hugging Face API metadata verification of Parakeet-line distillation and new-model candidates. Metadata only: no weights downloaded, no model run, no port attempt. Excludes NVIDIA-originated and Nemotron models per current scope.
method: tools/scripts/survey-hf-asr-candidates.mjs --search parakeet --limit 60 (62 records) plus per-model API verification of the strongest candidates.

candidates.reason: Only verified sub-300M Parakeet-line model: 148,923,399 parameters, about 4.2x smaller than the 627M TDT v3 line (and smaller than Orukeet). No ONNX graphs are published, so porting requires our own export.
candidates.next_step: Requires authority for a weight download plus an ONNX export from safetensors. Quantization character must be re-checked against the standing rule before promotion.

candidates.reason: Same 627M parameter class as Parakeet TDT v3, so it is not a student or size win; no ONNX published.

A third-party ONNX export of the stock v3 line, not a distillation. Could replace our own local v3 export, so it is a supply-chain option rather than a new port; our existing local export already works.
No parameter metadata and no ONNX in the repository record; architecture and size are unverified.
GGUF quantization of primeline; not a runtime format this library executes, and the standing rule treats integer quantization as a separate evidence-gated decision.

excluded_by_scope.reason: NVIDIA-originated; verified ONNX exists (onnx-community/parakeet-ctc-0.6b-ONNX with fp32/fp16/int8/q4) but out of the current scope.
NVIDIA-originated 114,639,495-parameter student. A genuine small student, but out of scope for now.
Fine-tune of an NVIDIA 110M CTC line; out of scope.

decision_needed: Authority to download moondream/parakeet-redux weights and run our own ONNX export. Without it the strongest verified candidate cannot be ported.
no_authority_used: No weights, downloads, installs or model runs were performed for this survey.
